description: This file defines a plugin class 'bootimg-biosplusefi' for the 'wic' image creation tool. The plugin creates a combined boot partition supporting both legacy BIOS and EFI boot methods, importing and coordinating other sub-plugins ('bootimg-pcbios' and 'bootimg-efi') to build a versatile boot partition. The class encapsulates methods for installation, configuration, and preparation of the partition, utilizing dynamic module import techniques to manage sub-plugins.

classes.name: BootimgBiosPlusEFIPlugin
classes.description: A plugin class for creating a combined BIOS and EFI boot partition, integrating sub-plugins for each boot method.

methods.description: Dynamically imports and instantiates the 'bootimg-pcbios' and 'bootimg-efi' sub-plugins.

methods.description: Performs installation of boot content onto the disk, invoking sub-plugins.

methods.description: Configures the partition prior to content population, invoking sub-plugins.

methods.description: Prepares the partition content, calling sub-plugins to populate it.
